_comment: The libgit2 wrap campaign's waves and batches. Waves 0-53 ran under the earlier specs, in the
order of their indices, and are kept as records: their items keep the homes of the time, a wave
whose items span several modules of modules.json has module null, and the raw-lifetime units of
waves 0 and 2 belong to none. Waves 54 on re-plan the whole public API, landed items included, from
the module decomposition: the modules in their order, each wave from its module's own wavefront
schedule (--api-headers-only --transitive, the workload caps), enums left to their -sys
definitions, src/util/alloc.c's allocator family added to its foundational wave, and before a
wave the public-signature dependencies it reaches in modules that run later (its module's cuts),
wrapped in waves of the modules that own them. Each translation wave is followed by its review
wave, within the review caps (20 types, 100 symbols).
